statusVocabulary.satisfied: The work package is implemented and has repository evidence.
statusVocabulary.transitional: The behavior exists in app-owned infrastructure but does not yet meet the controlling runtime policy.
statusVocabulary.partial: Some required behavior or evidence exists, but the work package is not complete.
statusVocabulary.decision-frozen: The governing decision is accepted; production implementation remains outstanding.
statusVocabulary.superseded: The historical work package is retained for traceability but no longer directs implementation.
statusVocabulary.owner-optional: Owner-operated hardware-only observation outside Agent Coding scope with no completion, blocking, residual-work, PASS/FAIL, or pull-request-readiness effect.
statusVocabulary.not-applicable: The conditional task has no approved input to include.
